# Loan & EMI calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/loan/

Estimate the monthly payment on a fixed-rate, reducing-balance loan. Review principal, total interest and total repayment together.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Compare a 60-month loan at 10% annual interest with a shorter repayment term.

## Limits and checks

The estimate excludes lender fees, insurance and variable-rate changes. A zero-interest loan divides principal by the number of months.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
